related: RNA polymerase II transcription cofactor binding
RNA polymerase II transcription coregulator binding

definition: Binding to a transcription coregulator, a protein involved in regulation of transcription via protein-protein interactions with transcription factors and other transcription regulatory proteins. Cofactors do not bind DNA directly, but rather mediate protein-protein interactions between regulatory transcription factors and the basal transcription machinery.
label: transcription coregulator binding
